structured_output.content: The release note only says cert-manager v1.18.0 adds a config option to the Vault issuer for setting the server-name used when checking the certificates the Vault server presents. That matters only where a Vault issuer is configured. The environment summary lists only cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, and the CRD dimension is marked absent, so I can't tell whether any Vault issuer is in use. Check your Issuer/ClusterIssuer resources for a Vault issuer, and if you have one, read PR #7663 to decide whether you need the new server-name setting.
